hints.title: Pairwise Operation Reduction
hints.text: At each step, select any two numbers from the remaining collection, apply one of the four arithmetic operations, and form a smaller list.

hints.title: Permutations and Divisions
hints.text: Order matters for subtraction and division. Check both a minus b and b minus a, as well as division avoiding division by zero.

hints.title: Floating Point Precision
hints.text: Recursively reduce the list until one number remains. Check whether the absolute difference between that final number and twenty-four is less than 1e-5.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Constant search tree bounded by picking pairs among at most 4 numbers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Parsing mathematical expression strings generates large overhead compared to direct numeric reduction.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place array reduction explores all operator combinations in constant recursion frames.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use floating point arithmetic with epsilon tolerance and handle non-commutative operations.
